title: Selective State-Space Adaptation and Retrieval for Language Model Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2607.19326v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Low-rank adaptation introduces a static learned update applied identically to every input. The update provides task-level adaptation but does not explicitly represent token-level or instance-level state variation. A family of adapters is proposed that introduces selective state-space control at two complementary granularities. At the token level, MaLoRA (Mamba-modulated low-rank adaptation) makes the adapter's scaling factor a dynamic input-dependent function with recurrent state across tokens, in contrast to the stateless modulators of prior work. The token-level adapter improves over low-rank adaptation. On the other hand, it differentiates tokens by structural role but not by contextual relevance, which motivates placing evidence selection at the context level. translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.19326v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：低秩自适应引入了一种静态学习更新，该更新对所有输入均相同应用。这种更新提供了任务级别的自适应，但并未明确表示令牌级别或实例级别的状态变化。提出了一系列适配器，在两种互补的粒度上引入选择性状态空间控制。在令牌级别上，MaLoRA（Mamba调制低秩自适应）使适配器的缩放因子成为一个动态的、输入相关的函数，并带有跨令牌的循环状态，这与先前工作的无状态调制器形成对比。令牌级适配器优于低秩自适应。另一方面，它根据结构角色区分令牌，而非上下文相关性，这促使将证据选择置于上下文级别。在上下文级别上，MaRA（Mamba检索适配器）跟踪跨段落推理状态，并选择与查询最相关的段落。状态空间控制的检索...
tldr: 本文提出两种选择性状态空间适配器（MaLoRA和MaRA），分别在令牌和上下文级别动态调控语言模型推理，以提升自适应能力和推理性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two selective state-space adapters (MaLoRA and MaRA) that dynamically modulate language model reasoning at token and context levels, improving adaptation and reasoning performance.
